urllib3.basis: Removed support for Python 2.7 and 3.6. urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl and urllib3.contrib.ntlmpool were removed. HTTPResponse.getheaders() and getheader() were removed; use .headers instead. The strict parameter of HTTPConnection was removed. Applications that call the removed APIs will fail to import after upgrading.

requests.basis: No public API was removed or renamed in this release. Existing code continues to work.

numpy.basis: The C ABI changed; extension modules compiled against 1.x must be rebuilt. Removed aliases np.float_, np.unicode_, np.Inf, np.NaN and ~100 other names. Downstream packages that were not rebuilt will raise ImportError at load time.

click.basis: This is a bugfix release. No behaviour of documented public APIs changed.

pydantic.basis: BaseModel.dict() and .json() are deprecated in favour of .model_dump() / .model_dump_json(). @validator is replaced by @field_validator with a different signature. Config inner class is replaced by model_config. parse_obj_as was removed. Nearly every V1 model definition needs edits before it will import under V2.

jinja2.basis: Security fix: the xmlattr filter now rejects keys containing spaces, /, > or =. No other user-visible change. Templates that do not pass such keys to xmlattr render identically to 3.1.3.

sqlalchemy.basis: The 1.x Query style is legacy; select() + Session.execute() is the supported form. Implicit autocommit was removed; a transaction must be begun explicitly. Engine.execute() and Connection.execute() with a plain string were removed; wrap SQL text in text(). Code relying on implicit autocommit or bare-string execute will raise at runtime.

attrs.basis: No deprecations took effect and no public API was removed in this release.

flask.basis: Dropped support for Python 3.7. Removed the deprecated __version__ attribute. Removed flask.Markup and flask.escape; import them from markupsafe. The app.before_first_request decorator was removed. Applications using before_first_request will fail to start after upgrading.

certifi.basis: Updated the bundled Mozilla CA root store: 3 roots added, 5 expired roots removed. The package exposes the same single function certifi.where(); the API is unchanged.

werkzeug.basis: Dropped support for Python 3.7. Removed the deprecated __version__ attribute. Request.get_data(as_text=True) now decodes as UTF-8 strictly and raises on invalid bytes. Removed werkzeug.urls.url_quote and the rest of the legacy urls helpers. Middleware importing werkzeug.urls.url_quote will fail to import.

packaging.basis: No public API was removed; 24.1 is a drop-in replacement for 24.0.
